Package it.polimi.ingsw.model.util

Class DynamicMap<K,T>

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.util.DynamicMap<K,T>
Type Parameters:
K - type of the elements key of the map
T - type of the elements of the map
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class DynamicMap<K,T> extends Object implements Serializable
Dynamic map which contains elements at a certain point in 2D space

    • insert

      public void insert(K key, T el, K targetKey, int pos) throws TargetNotPresentException, InvalidPositionException
      Insert an element in the map. Position is related to the target object.
      Parameters:
      key - key of the element
      el - element to be inserted
      targetKey - key of the object near which the element must be inserted
      pos - 0 = one point to the top left, 1 = one point to the top right, 2 = one point to the bottom left, 3 = one point to the bottom right
      Throws:
      TargetNotPresentException - if target object is not present
      InvalidPositionException - if pos is not a valid value

    • getElementAt

      public T getElementAt(K targetKey, int pos) throws TargetNotPresentException, InvalidPositionException
      Get the element value at a certain position relative to a particular object
      Parameters:
      targetKey - key of the object near which the element is
      pos - 0 = one point to the top left, 1 = one point to the top right, 2 = one point to the bottom left, 3 = one point to the bottom right 4 = two points on the top, 5 = two points on the bottom
      Returns:
      element at that position
      Throws:
      TargetNotPresentException - if target object is not present
      InvalidPositionException - if pos is not a valid value

    • getMapElementsLocation

      public List<Map<Point,T>> getMapElementsLocation()
      Creates a list of sorted maps with the elements of the map. Maps are sorted by y-position (descending), their elements are sorted by x-position (ascending).
      Returns:
      a list of maps representing a matrix: key is the position, value is the element
